edit.description: Middle emphasis with positive guidance throughout; same M2 reward
edit.interpolation: smoothstep; phase is normalized over observed score nodes; no extrapolation
edit.normalization: dose is normalized over actual score nodes to a mean of one

failure_modes: The mid-window dose emphasis does not improve the primary final predicted affinity relative to the M2 incumbent.
The observed coordinate contrasts are untyped proxies; the dose schedule changes the trace but produces no measurable affinity or validity benefit.
Per-seed realized dose deviates from the intended ratio budget under RMS normalization, so the intended mid-window emphasis is not actually delivered.
Strain or structural validity degrades even if affinity is unchanged, since coordinate control is only secondary to affinity.
The non-monotone profiles are batch noise (14 dependent batches, clones dependent), so the mid-window contrast is not reproducible.
rationale: Adopting H001, H002 and H003, each backed by its delivered curve handle (landmark_00_local_dx E4bbe368c52deda38, landmark_00_local_dy E11ca33646f5d0576, landmark_10_soft_mass Ee9d172f45c064a2e). The observed profiles are non-monotone with sign reversals and large opposite-signed endpoint rates, and no polynomial trend is accepted, so a single whole-window mean is not a defensible schedule. The registered dose lane W2_middle_peak concentrates the ratio budget at the mid-window knot (dose [0.5,1.5,0.5]) while keeping delta and blend fixed and preserving the frozen eta and M2 reward, which is the offered recipe that matches the mid-window excursion seen in H001 and the late-window decline in H003. W1/W3 are the opposite time-order controls and are not selected by this evidence. The score clock E0857891f4effbfe1 confirms the controlled nodes span [0.0,0.49] with no extrapolation.
